[SWS_CM_90471] E2E checking of the method response in the ServiceProxy
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00400, RS_E2E_08541
⌈
For E2E-protected
Method
responses, E2E checking shall be performed within the
context of the message reception within the
ServiceProxy
.
⌋

E2E checking of the
Method
